why: It answers my question about how a live patch is shown to people: the display and the code are the same thing.
content: In Weft Loom, every pattern is shown twice, as controls and as Strudel code, and the controls read and rewrite the code.
evidence: Every pattern of a song is shown twice: as controls and as Strudel code. The code is the song; the controls read it and rewrite it
